confirmed_findings.finding: Old startup helper did not stop at dollar after a glyph and omitted native consumed-byte/current-glyph state.

confirmed_findings.resolution: Replaced mapped owner with full native C and rerouted parents; live Ghidra static comparison, no replay.

confirmed_findings.finding: Selection-kind storage was DWORD but native MOV stores AL.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Changed C state and host storage to uint8_t; live Ghidra bytes retained.

confirmed_findings.finding: Native MOVSX reads a signed WORD; synthetic C snapshot was consumed as full int32_t.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Explicit int16_t projection before the existing percentage owner.

confirmed_findings.finding: Signed C speed subtraction and threshold multiply omitted native DWORD wrap.
C kept upper cameraY bits and omitted wrapped bounds; native masks with0000FFFEh and writes DCA BYTE.
Imported Event54SuppressFlood name caused false distinction from the actual editor flag and wrong sidebar dirty alias.
C inverted saved/current window, forced window1 and omitted native DE0 flag.
Integer pointer-token and snapshot state obscured real active-header pointer and DWORD return mode/hover state.
Ghidra __cdecl declaration contradicts ECX object and RET0Ch; parser cannot set thiscall. Caller code must follow assembly.
